verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual mailbox service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec (all 404). Its documented features are app and web-portal mail management only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
